title: SEBI AIF Master Circular Updated: A New Era for Accredited Investors and Compliance
content:
# SEBI AIF Master Circular Updated: A New Era for Accredited Investors and Compliance

Ek important update hai for all our Alternative Investment Fund (AIF) stakeholders! Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) ne **November 5, 2026** ko apna Master Circular for Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) update kiya hai. This latest revision consolidates various regulatory instructions, with a significant focus on the new Accredited Investor (AI) framework and enhanced compliance rules.

This move aims to simplify and streamline the regulatory landscape for AIFs, ensuring better investor protection and ease of compliance for fund managers.

Here’s a quick rundown of the key changes:

*   **New Accredited Investor Framework:** SEBI ne 'Accredited Investor' framework mein substantial changes introduce kiye hain. Ab, an optional 'Manager-led accreditation' mechanism allow kiya gaya hai.
*   **Manager-Led Accreditation:** Is naye mechanism ke under, eligible fund managers ab investors ki accredited status khud determine aur record kar sakte hain, without requiring them to obtain a separate certificate from a recognized Accreditation Agency.
*   **Validity Period:** Manager द्वारा निर्धारित accreditation ki validity teen saal (three years) hogi from the date of accreditation.
*   **Clarifications:** Circular ne qualifying securities market exposure, necessary documentation, Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs) ki accreditation, aur Persons Resident Outside India (NRIs) ke treatment par bhi clarifications provide kiye hain.
*   **Basis of Update:** Yeh naya framework, October 15, 2026 ko notify kiye गए SEBI (Alternative Investment Funds) Regulations, 2012 ke amendments ke baad aaya hai.
*   **Compliance Streamlining:** Master Circular ka overall objective AIF managers ke liye compliance ko streamline karna aur investor protection ko badhana hai.
